# PDL Portfolio OS (v2.5) — Machine Discovery & LLM Interface
> A production-grade frontend-first portfolio operating system for Prajwal DL (Web Advisor & Full Stack Developer).

## Core Identity
- **Owner**: Prajwal DL
- **Title**: Web Advisor & Full Stack Developer
- **Organization**: Unifycx (Enterprise Cloud & Web Infrastructure)
- **Specialization**: React 19, TypeScript, Frontend Architecture, DNS Migration, Performance Optimization
- **Location**: Bengaluru, India
- **Email**: contact@praxel.space
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/smhrimmy
- **Repository**: https://github.com/smhrimmy/protfoliov2

## System Architecture
- **Framework**: React 19, TypeScript 5+, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS 3
- **Graphics & 3D**: Three.js WebGL spatial engines, custom shaders, Canvas 2D fallback
- **State Management**: Reactive in-memory / local storage publisher (`mockStorage`) with instant UI synchronization
- **Routing**: Client-side path and hash routing with deep linking support across all themes
- **Audio Engine**: Web Audio API procedural sound synthesizer (menu ticks, cash chimes, wanted siren, radio static)

## Public Routes
- `/`: Main Portfolio Home page (renders the active theme out of 25 distinct architectural worlds)
- `/projects`: Dedicated Production Systems Catalog with search, stack filtering, and live demo triggers
- `/projects/:id`: Comprehensive Project Case Study detailing Problem, Architecture, Technologies, and Metrics
- `/about`: Professional engineering biography, technical tenets, and credentials
- `/experience`: Chronological career timeline and enterprise milestones
- `/skills`: Interactive skill radar with categorized technologies and mastery levels
- `/resume`: Interactive recruiter resume with printable PDF view at `/resume/print`
- `/blog`: Technical publications, architectural essays, and engineering insights
- `/blog/:slug`: Full article view with reading progress bar, table of contents, and discussion
- `/contact`: Direct communication portal and safehouse dispatch briefing
- `/search`: Global full-text search index across projects, essays, and skills
- `/rss.xml`: Content syndication XML feed preview
- `/llms.txt`: Machine discovery index for AI agents (Claude, GPT, Perplexity)
- `/llms-full.txt`: Full exhaustive documentation and content dump
- `/site-manifest.json`: Structured machine-readable JSON data manifest

## All 25 Structurally Distinct Themes
1. `theme-01-minimal-editorial`: Developer Portfolio (Claude Code inspired, monospace terminal accents)
2. `theme-02-brutalist`: Minimal Designer (high contrast #0a0a0a, large 2-column orderly thumbnails)
3. `theme-03-cyberpunk-hud`: UX/UI Designer (Ava Chen design-system-aware with 4-step methodology)
4. `theme-04-terminal-cli`: 3D Artist & Motion (interactive render pass switcher: wireframe/clay/lit)
5. `theme-05-galaxy-cosmos-3d`: Creative Technologist (interactive Three.js particle cosmos with orbit controls)
6. `theme-06-bento-showcase`: Full Stack Engineer (Apple-style modular bento grid with live metrics)
7. `theme-07-noir-aurora`: Dark ambient northern lights aurora glows with fluid glassmorphism
8. `theme-08-bauhaus-modernist`: Geometric constructivist shapes (circles, triangles, bold primary colors)
9. `theme-09-retro-desktop-os`: 90s desktop operating system with draggable windows, start menu, and taskbar
10. `theme-10-horizontal-scrolly`: Side-scrolling panoramic architectural timeline
11. `theme-11-kinetic-physics-3d`: Interactive 3D physics floating typography and canvas
12. `theme-12-blueprint-drafting`: Cyanotype architectural blueprint with technical drafting grids
13. `theme-13-swiss-typographic`: International typographic style with strict baseline grid
14. `theme-14-split-screen`: Dual-column independent scrolling with interactive pinned view
15. `theme-15-neumorphic-soft`: Soft tactile clay/neumorphic surfaces with debossed and embossed highlights
16. `theme-16-holographic-matrix`: Green phosphor digital rain with matrix cascade overlays
17. `theme-17-newspaper-broadside`: Classic broadsheet newspaper layout with multi-column serif text
18. `theme-18-spatial-canvas`: Three.js interactive 3D spatial node graph with rotatable camera
19. `theme-19-prajwal-luxury`: Obsidian black and bullion gold haute couture typography
20. `theme-20-monochrome-stark`: Stark black-and-white editorial layout with high visual discipline
21. `theme-21-cyber-deck`: Neon cyberpunk console with real-time ASCII telemetry feeds
22. `theme-22-animated-mascot`: Character-anchored sections with cursor-tracking mascot and physics
23. `theme-23-handtracked-lowpoly`: Three.js low-poly 3D portrait mesh with client-side camera hand tracking
24. `theme-24-the-journal`: Content-first developer writing ledger inspired by midhunnk.in (clean paper, quiet margins)
25. `theme-25-the-wanted-level`: Open-world crime game pause-menu UI with persistent HUD, cash odometer ($36M), 1–5 wanted stars with siren SFX, Wave FM tuner, tactical GPS radar minimap, and 3-card case study dossiers.

## Theme 25: "The Wanted Level" Specification
- **Metaphor**: Open-world crime game pause menu (Vice City / Leonida aesthetic).
- **Persistent Heads-Up Display (GameHUD)**:
  - Top-Left Operative Pill: Health (100%), Armor (77%), Energy (100), Active Arsenal (`TYPESCRIPT // REACT 19`).
  - Top-Center Radio: Interactive tuner (`98.4 WAVE FM`, `105.7 FLASH FM`, `101.1 FEVER FM`, `94.5 EMOTION FM`).
  - Top-Right Cluster: Live Clock, Rolling Cash Counter ($36,000,000 based on 36 repos), Interactive Wanted Heat Stars (1–5 stars with police siren SFX), and ESC Menu button.
  - Bottom Ticker: `VICE CITY INSPIRED • BUILD DIFFERENT • STAY LEGENDARY`.
  - Bottom-Right Quote: *"Code is my weapon. Creativity is my world." — Prajwal*.
- **Projects Showcase Layout**:
  - Left Nav Column: `START GAME`, `ABOUT ME`, `SKILLS`, `PROJECTS`, `EXPERIENCE`, `ACHIEVEMENTS`, `ACADEMY`, `CONTACT`, `EXIT GAME`. Active `PROJECTS` is a solid filled pink-purple gradient pill with chevron.
  - Page Title: `PROJECTS:` uppercase bold sans + `Case Studies` in italic pink script.
  - Three Stacked Info Cards:
    - Card 1: Cyan border box with Project title, Tech Stack badges, Completion %, LOC, and 5-star rating.
    - Card 2: Pink border box with Features numbered list.
    - Card 3: 2x3 thumbnail gallery matrix + full-width `VIEW LIVE DEMO ›` CTA pill in solid pink.
  - Tactical Minimap: Vector street grid with location pin, dashed route vector line, 360° sweeping beam, and dynamic `CURRENT OBJECTIVE` header.
  - Illustrated Artwork: Full-bleed right-side illustrated character working at desk on holographic blueprint with neon ocean drive skyline outside.

## Admin Operating System (`/admin`)
- `/admin/dashboard`: Executive control center with health radar, publishing lifecycle, and quick actions
- `/admin/visual-editor`: Professional visual site builder with multi-viewport responsive preview
- `/admin/themes`: Full-screen theme switcher & visual gallery
- `/admin/projects`: Project CMS with cover manager and tech stack selector
- `/admin/blog`: Markdown blog editor with live preview and reading time calculation
- `/admin/automations`: LinkedIn and social post queue with Telegram approval workflows
- `/admin/analytics`: Real-time traffic, recruiter sessions, and pageview intelligence
- `/admin/seo`: OpenGraph social card previews, SERP preview, and sitemap generator
- `/admin/recruiter`: Recruiter-optimized high-density resume and portfolio mode
- `/admin/media`: Asset library with upload, search, tag, and storage quota indicators
- `/admin/backup`: One-click JSON data export, migration, and restore engine

## Automated Agent & Testing Compatibility
- All interactive controls contain explicit `aria-label` and semantic tags for automated browser testing.
- No paywalls, CAPTCHAs, or authentication gates exist for public evaluation.
